tools.name: push
tools.description: Publish rows as a rows.page dataset (or a new version of one) and get a shareable URL. Pass exactly one of csv, tsv, jsonl, json, rows or url. Up to 16 MB inline; use url for bigger files. Identical content returns unchanged: true without a new version. Re-pushes report rows_delta, columns_added/rem

tools.name: pin_finding
tools.description: Pin a finding (a saved, titled view) to a dataset you own. Finding views use the rows.page query language in q: `word` or `"two words"` searches text columns; `field:value`, `field:"a b"`, `-field:value`, `field:*` (not null), `-field:*` (null), `field:foo*` (prefix); `field:>20`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Read a dataset: meta, recent versions, findings, columns and the first 20 preview rows.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the datasets kept on your account, newest first. Needs an API key.

tools.name: delete_dataset
tools.description: Delete a dataset you own. Its URL stops working immediately.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Show your plan, its caps (file size, datasets, version history) and usage.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "push" is 989 chars, far longer than this server's median (81). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: push · Private data: push, list_datasets, get_limits · Public sink: push · Destructive: delete_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: push · Private data: push, list_datasets, get_limits · Public sink: push · Destructive: delete_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
